g.text: Routing mesh: any node accepts the published port, even with no replica
Service "web" published on 8080 with 2 replicas on nodes 1 and 2.
The ingress overlay network exists on every node, so the node that received the request forwards it over VXLAN to whichever node holds a healthy replica.
Ingress is the only channel meant for outsiders; keep 2377, 7946 and 4789 reachable only by swarm nodes.
